observations: Two upholstered sofas in a tiled room.
Sofas are a light brown or beige color with a soft, velvety texture.
Each sofa has two large square back cushions and two armrest cushions.
Gold-colored diamond-shaped fabric appliqués are visible on the front of each armrest.
The sofas appear to be in good cosmetic condition with no visible tears or stains in the photo.
Watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI PHEEBS AUDU' is present on the image.

risks.risk: The foam may be compressed or have hidden tears.

proof_requests: Photos of the sofas with the backrests and seat cushions fully open.
Close-up photos of the seat cushions and back cushions.

response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a sofa set from the photos, so it can be priced at its worst case (used) while the seller's condition claims remain unverified.
